name: Suki Suki Master
source:
I love my master, so whatever he asks I want to do. 

The romantic days of Master and Len Kag*mine. 
A new afterstory ADV novel to the love ending of "Lenaiholic". 
* You can enjoy this story standalone.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE084608.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我爱主人，所以无论他要求什么，我都愿意照做。

主人与镜音连的浪漫时光。
《Lenaiholic》恋爱结局的全新后日谈ADV小说。
*本故事也可以独立欣赏。

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE084608.html]DLsite English[/url]]
